name: Parallax Showcase
description: Full-screen smooth-scrolling story with alternating uppercase headings and wide images that move at different speeds, creating layered parallax depth over a dark background.
contents: Story sections, each with a large heading, optional body text and a wide image
Alternating left and right text and image layout
behavior: Headings and images move at different speeds for parallax depth
Scroll triggers refresh when the content size changes
editableByProps: Number of sections, headings, body text, images and left or right layout per section
Background, text color and image opacity through Tailwind classes
Smoothness, parallax speeds, content width and section spacing
Google font names for heading and body

needsCodeEdit.change: Change heading letter spacing or size
Change the five-column text and image overlap

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with ScrollSmoother and renders as a fixed full-screen layer, so it should be the only scroll container on the page
Loads the heading and body fonts from Google Fonts
Section layout alternates through the layout value left or right on each section
